device.name: Bambu Lab LAN printer (mhs.drivers.bambu.printer:BambuPrinter)

facts.text: BambuPrinter builds one BambuMqtt, one BambuFiles and one BambuCamera from the configured host, serial and access code
The MQTT transport defines device/<serial>/request and device/<serial>/report topic names
The MQTT client uses username bblp and the printer access code
publish_and_wait publishes and waits up to 6 s for a report with the same sequence_id; a missing acknowledgement is returned as acknowledged false rather than raised
pause, resume and stop are print commands carrying an empty param
start_print refuses unless the printer accepts a new job and reports no fatal or serious alert, then publishes project_file and waits for its report
project_file needs a .3mf, .gcode or .gcode.3mf path and a plate index of at least 1
set_temperature rejects a nozzle target outside 0-300 C and a bed target outside 0-120 C
Temperatures are sent as M104 and M140 gcode because the firmware has no dedicated JSON temperature command
The firmware speed presets are 1 silent, 2 standard, 3 sport and 4 ludicrous
set_light sends ledctrl for the chamber_light or work_light node with led_mode on or off
calibrate refuses an active printer, calls commands.calibration with its keyword arguments and publishes the result
The printer module declares _MIN_PUSHALL_INTERVAL=300.0 and _STALE_AFTER=90.0
status refreshes stale telemetry with force=True, waits 1 s and returns the merged cached status
_refresh skips requests within the minimum interval only when force is false
The A1/P1 chamber camera streams 1280x720 JPEG frames at roughly 1 fps over a TLS socket
The camera declares a 16-byte header size and an 8 MiB maximum frame size
The printer moves fast and reaches 220 C or more: it can burn, pinch and start a fire if left unattended with a fault
The bed rating depends on the model: 80 C for the A1 mini, 100 C for the A1/P1P/P1S and 110 C for the X1 Carbon
Firmware 01.05 and newer on the A1 series silently ignores start, stop and heat commands unless Developer Mode is enabled
The README safety model puts start_print, upload_and_print, stop_print and send_gcode behind a confirmation gate
A stopped Bambu print job cannot be resumed

safe_state.description: no safe state is confirmed: the e-stop requests print.stop and zero nozzle/bed targets, then fails SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held; MQTT echoes and merged cached fields prove neither physical standstill nor heater shutdown, and a hot printer remains hot
